title: SERP Snippet Preview – Meta Title and Description Checker
description: Free meta title and description checker with live Google SERP preview. See exactly how your title and meta truncate on desktop & mobile before you publish.
previewDesc: How it will appear in search results

previewDescDefault: Your meta description will appear here. Make it compelling to improve click-through rates from search results.

how.title: How the SERP Preview Tool Works
paragraphs: Type (or paste) a page title and meta description and the tool renders them inside a simulated Google result — desktop and mobile — using pixel-width estimation that matches how Google actually truncates snippets. Wide characters, ALL-CAPS words, and long brand suffixes all cut off sooner than raw character counts suggest.

The counters update as you type: green means the length is in the ideal band (roughly 50–60 characters / 580px for titles, 110–160 characters / 990px for descriptions), yellow means short of it, red means Google will trim your text mid-sentence.

useCases.title: When to Use This Tool
items: Before publishing any new page: verify the snippet reads fully on both desktop and mobile widths.
When rewriting meta tags on existing pages to recover click-through rate without changing rankings.
Comparing two candidate titles side by side to pick the one that survives truncation with the keyword intact.
